text_block_list.text:
As Stay Gold sustained an injury while 
training, she was taken to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
You got me there. I managed to stuff up 
spectacularly.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I understand that I should probably wind 
down for a while but…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
If I lag behind now, we'll end up with a 
big gap in the middle of our journey.

These were the words spoken quietly by the 
girl. I could tell she was forcibly trying 
to return to training but…
choice_data_list: Then I'll leave it up to you

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
choice_data_list:
…Let's not make it worse. Just rest for 
me.
…Let's not make it worse. Just rest.

text_block_list.text:
If she acts recklessly now, it would 
affect her next races, and end up 
influencing her life… I confronted her 
directly with these words.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I see… So those are you earnest words as 
my trainer huh.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: I got it. I'll trust your judgement.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oh…… If that's what you're suggesting, 
then that means you thought this through?

I listed out all the gentle exercises I 
could think of right now. She looked 
convinced, and started to move…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ——Kuh……! Wait a sec, any more than this might be too much.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
It's my bad, I got too enthusiastic about 
it. Following my whims may not have been 
the best idea hey…

Despite coming up with a gentler training 
regime, the injury still seems serious… 
For the time being, we gave up on training 
and rested.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
This is good! It seems like there's less 
burden on my body if I exercise in water.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Also, it's kinda fun, feels sort of fresh 
compared to normal training.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I really have to give it to you Trainer, 
you helped me out. Let's keep it up!
